note: Missing `bundleId`. There is no default bundle, and an absent handle must never read as 'all of my open bundles' — abort is destructive, and a fan-out is the last thing an omitted member should mean.
`bundleId` that is not a UUID. The pattern is what keeps a crafted handle from reaching the recipient's store as a lookup key.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.

Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `force`. Abort has no forced variant: it already discards the bytes, and a member suggesting a harder version would be read as one by an implementer who has not checked.
